The distribution of [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] scores among patients with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] reveals distinct differences in risk profiles between men and women. Based on data from 2024, men are more frequently found at the lowest end of the risk spectrum, while women are more concentrated in the middle scores.

Men represent the largest group at a score of 0, with 21.44% (17,164 patients) falling into this lowest risk category, compared to 13.46% (7,586 patients) of women [^src1]. Conversely, women lead in the intermediate risk categories. At a score of 1, women account for 36.06% (20,327 patients) compared to 34.34% (27,489 patients) of men [^src1]. This gap widens at a score of 2, where 32.39% (18,260 patients) of women are found, compared to 27.15% (21,730 patients) of men [^src1]. 

Overall, the dataset includes a larger total population of men (80,045) than women (56,375) [^src1]. As the scores increase from 3 to 6, the percentages for both genders decline steadily, with men maintaining slightly higher percentages at scores 4, 5, and 6, though the absolute numbers remain small [^src1]. Because this comparison relies on a single dated section, no longitudinal trends can be established, and no specific clinical targets or thresholds are recorded in the table.

## Table: AFDK_2024.pdf, p. 92

Rows compare: køn · Columns show: CHA2DS2-VASc score og procentandel

| Køn | CHA2DS2-VASc score | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | I alt |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| K | Antal % | 7586 13.46 | 20327 36.06 | 18260 32.39 | 8019 14.22 | 1850 3.28 | 308 0.55 | 25 0.04 | 56375 |
| M | Antal % | 17164 21.44 | 27489 34.34 | 21730 27.15 | 9875 12.34 | 3075 3.84 | 657 0.82 | 55 0.07 | 80045 |

Entities: cha2ds2-vasc, atrieflimren

Summary: Tabellen viser, at mænd har en højere andel af lavere CHA2DS2-VASc-scorer (0: 21.4% vs. kvinder 13.5%), mens kvinder har en højere andel af midterste scorere (1–2), hvilket afspejler kønsforskelle i risikoprofil.
